'''Habon''' was the fifth [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Ea/Legends|Ea]] in the [[Geonosis system/Legends|Geonosis system]], located in the [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Habon was a [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] with twenty-one [[Moon/Legends|moon]].<ref name="EA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Despite the [[2004]] sourcebook ''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]'' listing the full composition of the [[Geonosis system/Legends|Geonosis system]] as five planets,<ref name="GW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> the [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], added a sixth planet, Habon, to the star system.<ref name="EA" />
